# TMPlayer

> TMPlayer is a free, open source, unofficial Telegram media player that plays the videos in your own Telegram chats on Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones, Windows, macOS and Linux, while they are still downloading. You sign in to your own Telegram account by scanning a QR code; it has no server and no bot, the app talks to Telegram directly. It is not affiliated with Telegram.

Licence: GPL-3.0. Not the same app as "TMP - Telegram Media Player" on Google Play (com.tmp.com), which is made by another developer; several apps describe themselves as a Telegram media player.

Key facts:

- Platforms: Android 8.0 and above (phones, Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV), Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), Linux x86_64 (AppImage, and a PKGBUILD for Arch). macOS, a preview since 1.26.0: a DMG for Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 and later) running macOS 26 or newer, not notarized by Apple, and no Intel Macs. There is no iPhone or iPad version.
- Playback: MKV, MP4, AVI, TS and more, with embedded and external subtitles, several audio tracks and autoplay of the next episode. Media3 with FFmpeg decoders on Android, mpv on the desktop.
- Library: Home opens on Continue watching, then what was recently added to starred chats, Watch later, new episodes and a row for each starred chat. Films and shows get posters and overviews (looked up on TMDB, TVmaze and AniList by the cleaned-up file title, and it can be switched off); a show is one tile with its own page of seasons, forum topics are tabs, and copies of one film fold into one poster. Whole seasons download at once, and a chat of lessons shows how far through the course you are.
- Player extras: skip intro and credits, speed remembered per series, preferred audio and subtitle languages, bookmarks, A-B repeat, skip silence and a short rewind on resume.
- Privacy and control: an app PIN, a kids lock limited to chosen chats, backup and restore of settings and lists to a file, and an interface size setting.
- Price: free, with nothing locked behind payment. Source code: https://github.com/dracu-lah/TMPlayer
- Installed copies update themselves; every release is built by GitHub Actions from the tagged source, with a SHA-256 for every file.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tmplayer.org/): what TMPlayer is, with screenshots of the TV, phone and desktop apps
- [Features](https://tmplayer.org/features/): streaming while downloading, instant seeking, subtitles, Home and series pages, skip intro, bookmarks, the app lock, the TV and desktop layouts, a row of new videos on the Android TV home screen, keyboard shortcuts
- [Download](https://tmplayer.org/download/): the APK for Android TV and phones, the Windows installer, the macOS DMG and the Linux AppImage
- [How to install](https://tmplayer.org/install/): Android TV with the Downloader app and `tmplayer.org/apk`, Android phones, Windows with one PowerShell line (`irm https://tmplayer.org/install.ps1 | iex`) or the MSI installer, Linux with the AppImage, macOS with the DMG and "Open Anyway" in Privacy and Security on the first launch
- [Android TV](https://tmplayer.org/android-tv/): watching Telegram videos on Android TV and Google TV
- [Windows, macOS and Linux](https://tmplayer.org/desktop/): the desktop app, a Telegram video player for a computer built with Compose Multiplatform and played through mpv: signing in by QR code, streaming while downloading, self update, the main keyboard shortcuts, and which computers it runs on (no iPhone or iPad version)
- [Fire TV](https://tmplayer.org/fire-tv/): installing on a Fire TV Stick, Cube or Fire TV Edition TV
- [Formats](https://tmplayer.org/formats/): the containers, codecs and subtitle formats it plays
- [Questions](https://tmplayer.org/faq/): streaming without waiting, which file to download, privacy, what it will not do
- [Changelog](https://tmplayer.org/changelog/): every release, newest first, with a page per release and an RSS feed at https://tmplayer.org/changelog/feed.xml

- [How to watch Telegram videos on Fire TV](https://tmplayer.org/guides/telegram-videos-on-fire-tv/)

## For agents

Stable addresses that do not change between releases:

- https://tmplayer.org/latest.json: the newest version, its release notes, and the download URL, SHA-256 and size of each platform's file (what installed copies check for updates)
- https://tmplayer.org/apk: redirects to the newest universal Android APK (phones, Android TV, Fire TV)
- https://tmplayer.org/install.ps1: the Windows installer script, run as `irm https://tmplayer.org/install.ps1 | iex`
- https://tmplayer.org/changelog/feed.xml: RSS feed of releases
- https://tmplayer.org/sitemap.xml: every page, in every language
- https://github.com/dracu-lah/TMPlayer/releases: every release file with its SHA-256

## Optional

- [Security](https://tmplayer.org/security/): how releases are built and how to check a download
- [Privacy](https://tmplayer.org/privacy/): what stays on the device and which services it contacts
- [Lawful use](https://tmplayer.org/legal/): use it only with content you own or may access
- [Support](https://tmplayer.org/support/): sponsoring, starring and sharing
